main_text.head: AD LECTOREM BENEVOLUM.
main_text.p: POstquam ante aliquot annos tractatum de ERUDITIONE pollicitus sum, idem mihi fere accidit ac Cartesio, qui librum ejusdem argumenti aggressus, eum non perfecit, forte nec inceperat. Et ille quidem ob principiorum suorum insufficientiam (ut sic dicam) ab opere ejusmodi non poterat non abstinere. Ego vero ob rationes à Lectorum parte desumendas, & alicubi dicendas, laborem inceptum interrumpere & premere decreveram, nisi crebris amicorum instantiis, quando post partem primam libri primi per triennium & ultra ab opere cessaveram, illud ut resumerem absolveremque impulsus fuissem novissime. Inde ergo nunc
main_text.notes: The opening word "Postquam" is set with a large decorated woodcut initial P; transcribed as "POstquam" with the initial joined. The printed text reads "Ostquam" in the scan's first line; the letter is ambiguous and may be "O" or "P" (not marked, see scan). Spelling of "ultra" and "Lectorum" as printed. Text ends mid-sentence and continues on the next page.
